description:
[Merchant] Create a new product for inventory management and payment processing.

**Product Structure:**
📦 **PRODUCT METADATA**: name, shortDescription, longDescription, sku, upc, shippable, active, shop
💰 **PRODUCT DATA** (prData object): type, regularPrice, currency, overlapPriority, timeToLive, activeFrom, activeTo, timeZone
⚙️ **PRODUCT OPTIONS** (prOptions object): imageUrl, termsUrl, termsText

**Required:** name
**Optional:** All other parameters have sensible defaults

active.description: Indicates if product can serve as payment source

activeFrom.description: Product active state starting date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

activeTo.description: Product active state ending date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

imageUrl.description: URL pointing to external product image resource

overlapPriority.description: Priority when overlapping price schedules exist

partnerId.description: Merchant partner ID (uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default)

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication (uses environment-specific private key as default)

regularPrice.description: Product regular price as a decimal string. Zero or positive, at most 12 integer digits, and no more decimals than the currency's minor unit (0 for JPY, 2 for EUR, 3 for KWD, 8 for BTC). Returned as a string too.

shippable.description: Indicates if product requires delivery address

shop.description: Shop code (if not supplied, default shop is used)

termsUrl.description: URL pointing to external terms and conditions resource

timeToLive.description: Time allowed for product payment in seconds (60-2592000)

timeZone.description: Product state scheduling timezone (IANA format, e.g., 'Europe/Sofia')

name: payware_products_create_product
